items.title: Approve Amendments No. 1 to Contract Nos. PRO.0254.A and B, Project Scheduling and Cost Control Staff Augmentation Services, with CM Pros
items.text: Approve Amendments No. 1 to Contract Nos. PRO.0254.A and B, Project Scheduling and Cost Control Staff Augmentation Services, with CM Pros (PRO.0254.A) and with PMA Consultants LLC and Dabri Joint Venture (PRO.0254.B), increasing each contract by $1,500,000, for a total not-to-exceed contract amount of $9,000,000 per contract, with no change to the contract duration, to continue to provide program/project scheduling, critical path method scheduling, forecasting, change control, cost controls, and cost estimating for currently initiated capital improvement projects in the SFPUC Capital Plan

items.title: Public Hearing to consider Two-Year Capital Budget of the San Francisco Public Utilities Commission consisting of $1,163,787,041 for FY 2026-27 and $1,316,552,550 for FY 2027-28
items.text: Public Hearing to consider and possible action to adopt Two-Year Capital Budget of the San Francisco Public Utilities Commission consisting of $1,163,787,041 for FY 2026-27 and $1,316,552,550 for FY 2027-28 in conformance with San Francisco Administrative Code Section 3.3(c)); and authorize the General Manager to seek Board of Supervisors approval for the issuance of (1) $551,871,916 aggregate principal amount of Water Revenue Bonds and other forms of indebtedness, including commercial paper and State Revolving Fund (SRF) loans, (2) $1,165,736,266 aggregate principal amount of Wastewater Revenue Bonds and other forms of indebtedness, including commercial paper and SRF loans, and (3) $138,164,938 aggregate principal amount of Power Revenue Bonds and other forms of indebtedness, including commercial paper and loans, subject to the terms of Charter Sections 9.107(6) and 9.107(8). Anna Duning, Budget Director and Erin Corvinova Financial Planning Director

items.title: Approve the Water Supply Assessment for the proposed Matson Block Project
items.text: Approve the Water Supply Assessment for the proposed Matson Block Project (located at 215 Market Street, 215 Market Street Annex, 245 Market Street, 50 Main Street, 77 Beale Street, 45 Beale Street, and 25 Beale Street), pursuant to the State of California Water Code Section 10910 et seq., California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Section 21151.9, and CEQA Guidelines Section 15155

items.title: Award Progressive Design-Build Contract No. DB-141, Southeast Water Pollution Control Plant Nutrient Reduction, to Jacobs/PCL
items.text: Award Progressive Design-Build Contract No. DB-141, Southeast Water Pollution Control Plant Nutrient Reduction, to Jacobs/PCL, a SF Joint Venture between Jacobs Project Management Company and PCL Construction Inc., to design and construct secondary treatment facilities to achieve effluent quality requirements set forth in performance requirement of Nutrient Watershed Permit (CA0038873), with an initial award in the amount not-to-exceed $192,799,000, and with a total contract duration of 4,850 consecutive calendar days (approximately 13 years and three months), which includes a duration of 1,460 consecutive calendar days (approximately four years), to provide pre-construction services (e.g., planning, design, and environmental review)
